context: Owner asked to search Muse India, Muse Asia and Muse Hindi Dub for anime/episodes not on the site. Full upload windows were enumerated with yt-dlp (Muse India 1,600 rows, Muse Asia 1,200 rows, Muse Hindi Dub all 225 rows) and diffed against the catalogue by video ID. Candidates were verified with the repo gate (reviewed channel ID, public/embeddable, full runtime, India in country metadata, oEmbed author match). YouTube throttled this server's IP heavily during the run (HTTP 429 on most checks after an initial parallel pass); stage 1 imports only the 33 episodes that fully passed. A slow completion pass (2-hour cooldown, 30s spacing, resumable) is re-checking the ~520 remaining candidates; results will be imported as stage 2. Nothing was imported on a failed or throttled check.
integrity: Append-only. Untouched titles asserted byte-identical in the import script; existing episodes unchanged.
